title: Finite affine generators cover the stalk unit locus
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $I$ a quasi-coherent finite-type $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], and $\iota:I\hookrightarrow\mathcal O_X$ a monomorphism [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $U$ be an open such that $x\in U$ iff $\iota_x$ is surjective [def-pc-module-stalk-functor]. For every affine open $V$, set $R=\mathcal O_X(V)$ and $J=\operatorname{im}(\iota(V))\subseteq R$. There exist $t\geq0$ and $g:\operatorname{Fin}(t)\to R$ such that $J=(g_i\mid i<t)$ and $U\cap V=\bigcup_{i<t}D_V(g_i)$. Here $D_V(g_i)$ is the basic open in $V$ defined by $g_i$.

source.place: Lemma 01PM (lemma-sections-over-quasi-compact-open-in-affine), proof, denominator construction; Lemma 01PQ (lemma-sections-over-quasi-compact-open), affine reduction. Read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PM and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PQ.

proof.text: The existing finite_sections_of_finiteType helper gives finiteness of I(V). Its image J is finitely generated; choose a finite family g.

The unit-module stalk isomorphism identifies the map on module stalks with a linear map into the ring stalk and carries section germs to ring germs. If it is surjective, lift 1, represent the lift on a neighborhood, and shrink so its image is 1. Choose a basic neighborhood D(f) inside it. Localization expresses the I-section as a global section divided by a power of f, whose image has unit germ. Conversely a member of J with unit germ makes the stalk image ideal contain a unit, hence equal the ring. Thus x belongs to U iff some r in J has x in D(r). The equality zeroLocus_span then replaces all r in J by the finite generators g_i.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_ideal_generator_cover
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {I : X.Modules}
    (ι : I ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) [Mono ι]
    [I.IsQuasicoherent] [I.IsFiniteType] (U : X.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ x : X, x ∈ U ↔ Function.Surjective
      ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).map ι).hom)
    (V : X.affineOpens) :
    ∃ (t : ℕ) (g : Fin t → Γ(X, V.1)),
      (LinearMap.range (ι.val.app (op V.1)).hom : Ideal Γ(X, V.1)) =
        Ideal.span (Set.range g) ∧ U ⊓ V.1 = ⨆ i, X.basicOpen (g i)
